title: Don't Use a Cannon to Kill a Fly: Lightweight Model Editing for LLMs to Correct Deprecated API Recommendations
core_idea: Per-API layer importance scoring from gradient magnitudes separates common from API-specific layers before lightweight editing
baselines: Pre-edit; REPLACEAPI; ROME; MEMIT; PMET; AlphaEdit; GRACE; A-GRACE; MALMEN; FT-L; LoRA; AdaLoRA
metrics: Exact match (EM); API exact match (AEM); BLEU; ROUGE-L; editing time; peak memory; HumanEval Pass@1 (retained utility)
metrics_display: Exact match; API exact match; BLEU; ROUGE-L; editing time; peak memory

title: Model Editing for LLMs4Code: How Far Are We?
core_idea: Adds a contrastively trained MLP encoder to GRACE and uses mean-pooled token representations instead of the last token
baselines: FT-L; ROME; MEMIT; PMET; MALMEN; GRACE
metrics: Exact match (EM); BLEU; ROUGE-L; fluency (n-gram entropy); editing time; peak memory
metrics_display: Exact match; BLEU; ROUGE-L; n-gram entropy; editing time; peak memory

title: ReCode: Updating Code API Knowledge with Reinforcement Learning
core_idea: Rule-based reinforcement fine-tuning with a format reward and AST-syntax-checked string-similarity reward
metrics: Pass@1; Pass@5; retained coding performance on HumanEval+

title: Neuron Patching: Semantic-based Neuron-level Language Model Repair for Code Generation
core_idea: Attributes neuron scores then estimates patches that pull representations from the argmax semantic basis toward the target basis
metrics: Exact match (EM); edit similarity; BLEU; ROUGE-L; updated-neuron cost; elapsed-time cost; accuracy change (dAcc); mean absolute error (MAE) of probability-gap changes; root mean square error (RMSE) of probability-gap changes; update footprint (patch coefficient times updated-neuron cost)
benchmark: CoNaLa; IA32; TLDR; HumanEval; BigCodeBench-hard; handcrafted generalization and specificity probes
metrics_display: Exact match; edit similarity; BLEU / ROUGE-L; accuracy change; probability-gap change; neuron and time cost

title: CREME: Robustness Enhancement of Code LLMs via Layer-Aware Model Editing
core_idea: Locates the layer most sensitive to perturbation then aligns perturbed and clean hidden representations there
metrics: Pass@1; Generalized Relative Improvement Ratio (G-RIR); localization time; editing time; testing time
metrics_display: Pass@1; generalized relative improvement ratio; localization, editing and testing time

title: Mitigating Package Hallucinations in Large Language Models via Model Editing
core_idea: Locates attention and feed-forward modules by package-validity risk and optimizes boundary-aware LoRA adapters while freezing backbone weights
metrics: Sample-level hallucination rate (Sample-HR); package-level hallucination rate (Package-HR); valid-package response rate (Valid-Rate); Pass@1; Pass@10; retained coding performance on HumanEval; localization time; editing time; testing time; artifact size
benchmark: Model-specific high-risk package recommendation prompts; HumanEval
metrics_display: Sample-level hallucination rate; package-level hallucination rate; valid-package response rate; Pass@1/10; time; artifact size

title: Understanding Robustness of Model Editing in Code LLMs
core_idea: Shows execution-based metrics contradict similarity-based ones because code admits workarounds
baselines: FT-L; GRACE; A-GRACE; MALMEN; MEMIT; PMET; ROME
metrics: Compiles@k; Pass@k; Successful Adoption@k; Workaround@k; Shapley compilation contribution (phiC); Shapley post-compilation contribution (phiQ); compilation-attributed degradation share (CF)
metrics_display: Compiles@k; Pass@k; Successful Adoption@k; Workaround@k; compilation and post-compilation contributions

title: CodeUpdateArena: Benchmarking Knowledge Editing on API Updates
core_idea: Synthesizes API updates with program-synthesis tasks so editing is scored by execution rather than string match
metrics: UPass@k; SPass@k (retained coding performance on HumanEval); Pass@k with updated API

title: CodeSync: Synchronizing LLMs with Dynamic Code Evolution at Scale
core_idea: Mines real API signature changes and synthesizes paired legacy and updated invocations for completion, correction, and multiple-choice evaluation
metrics: BLEU; ROUGE-L; relative edit distance (RED); CodeBLEU; multiple-choice answer success (Pass@1/3/5); retained coding Pass@1 on HumanEval; HumanEval retention ratio; training time
metrics_display: BLEU / CodeBLEU; ROUGE-L; relative edit distance; answer success; retained coding Pass@1; training time

title: A Semantic-based Optimization Approach for Repairing LLMs: Case Study on Code Generation
core_idea: Locates buggy neurons, solves semantic analytical patches, and applies shortest-path planning to repair code LMs without full retraining
metrics: Exact match; BLEU; repair accuracy; time cost; relative performance drop (RPD) on held-out CoNaLa; degradation percentage; mean absolute error (MAE) of probability-gap changes; root mean square error (RMSE) of probability-gap changes; Generalization-Specificity Harmonic score (GSH)
metrics_display: Exact match; BLEU; repair accuracy; relative performance drop; generalization-specificity scores; time cost

title: Diagnosing Knowledge Gaps in LLM Tool Use: An Agentic Benchmark for Novel API Acquisition
core_idea: Dynamically discovers novel APIs per base model, decomposes knowledge bundles, and diagnoses failures across six categories comparing RAG vs parametric adaptation
baselines: RAG (knowledge components); SFT; RAFT; GRACE; MEMIT; AlphaEdit; no-knowledge baseline
metrics: Pass@1; Pass@5; API-selection accuracy; parameter correctness (AST keyword-argument match rate); semantic-equivalence judge score; failure-category distribution
metrics_display: Pass@1/5; API-selection accuracy; parameter correctness; semantic-equivalence score; failure categories

title: Environment-Aware Code Generation: How far are We?
target: Environment-specific executable code under explicit library versions
core_idea: Introduces VersiBCB for multi-package executable code generation under explicit library versions and explores RAG, LoRA-MoE, and memory-augmented adaptation
base_models: DeepSeek-Coder-7B; CodeGemma-7B-it; CodeLlama-13B; StarCoder2-15B; LLaMA3-70B; GPT-4.1-mini; DeepSeek-v3; GPT-4o-mini; GPT-4.1-nano; Gemini-1.5-flash-002; GPT-3.5-turbo; LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct
baselines: Unadapted base model; RAG; LoRA-MoE; Memory-augmented generation
metrics: Pass@1; Pass@3; Pass@5; weighted Pass@1 (wPass@1); strict Pass@1 (Strict@1); lenient Pass@1 (Lenient@1)
metrics_display: Pass@1/3/5; weighted Pass@1; strict Pass@1; lenient Pass@1

title: Understanding and Improving Model Editing for Secure Code Generation
core_idea: First systematic empirical study of model editing for secure code generation; evaluates UltraEdit/DINM/DEFER* vs CoSec and proposes SafeEdit, a post-edit refinement combining functional tuning with edit-aware regularization
base_models: LLaMA-3.1-8B; LLaMA-3.2-3B; DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B; CodeGen-6B; Qwen2.5-Coder-7B; Qwen2.5-Coder-3B; StarCoder-3B; StarCoder-7B
metrics: Security ratio (SR); Pass@1; Pass@5; Pass@10; Secure@1-Pass; Secure-Pass@1; TradeOff; training and editing time; inference latency
edited_models: LLaMA-3.1-8B; LLaMA-3.2-3B; DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B; CodeGen-6B; Qwen2.5-Coder-7B; Qwen2.5-Coder-3B; StarCoder-3B; StarCoder-7B
metrics_display: Security ratio; Pass@1/5/10; joint security-correctness; TradeOff; editing time; inference latency
